description: This file defines the PcaConnectorScepClient class in the AWS SDK for PHP, which interacts with the Private CA Connector for SCEP service. It primarily includes method annotations for interacting with various API endpoints related to challenges and connectors.

classes.name: PcaConnectorScepClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with the Private CA Connector for SCEP service in AWS SDK

methods.name: createChallenge
methods.description: Creates a challenge for the SCEP operation.

methods.description: Asynchronously creates a challenge for the SCEP operation.

methods.name: getChallengeMetadataAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves metadata for a challenge.

methods.name: getChallengePassword
methods.description: Retrieves the password for a challenge.
